"""Regression tests for pagination defect."""

import pytest

from pagekit import Page, paginate


def test_final_partial_page_is_returned() -> None:
    """Verify that the final partial page is returned when items are not an exact multiple of page size."""
    items = list(range(10))
    page = paginate(items, 3, 4)
    assert page.items == [9]
    assert page.number == 4
    assert not page.has_next
    assert page.has_previous


def test_total_pages_counts_partial_page() -> None:
    """Verify that total_pages includes the partial page."""
    items = list(range(10))
    assert paginate(items, 1, 3).total_pages == 4
    assert paginate(items, 1, 4).total_pages == 3
    assert Page(number=1, per_page=5, total_items=11).total_pages == 3


def test_penultimate_page_has_next() -> None:
    """Verify that the penultimate page reports has_next as True."""
    items = list(range(10))
    page = paginate(items, 3, 3)
    assert page.items == [6, 7, 8]
    assert page.has_next


def test_empty_sequence_has_one_empty_page() -> None:
    """Verify that an empty sequence returns one empty page."""
    page = paginate([], 1, 3)
    assert page.items == []
    assert page.total_pages == 1
    assert not page.has_next and not page.has_previous


def test_pages_beyond_last_still_raise() -> None:
    """Verify that requesting a page beyond the last valid page raises ValueError."""
    items = list(range(10))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^page number out of range$"):
        paginate(items, 5, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^page number out of range$"):
        paginate(list(range(9)), 4, 3)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^page number out of range$"):
        paginate([], 2, 3)


def test_argument_errors_are_unchanged() -> None:
    """Verify that argument validation errors are unchanged."""
    items = list(range(10))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^per_page must be at least 1$"):
        paginate(items, 1, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^page number must be at least 1$"):
        paginate(items, 0, 3)


def test_input_is_not_mutated() -> None:
    """Verify that the input sequence is not mutated."""
    data = list(range(7))
    paginate(data, 3, 3)
    assert data == list(range(7))

import pytest

from pagekit import page_numbers, paginate


def test_exact_multiple_pages() -> None:
    page = paginate(list(range(9)), 2, 3)

    assert page.items == [3, 4, 5]
    assert page.total_pages == 3
    assert page.has_next and page.has_previous


def test_last_full_page_has_no_next() -> None:
    page = paginate(list(range(9)), 3, 3)

    assert page.items == [6, 7, 8]
    assert not page.has_next
    assert page_numbers(page) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_rejects_invalid_arguments() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="per_page must be at least 1"):
        paginate([1, 2], 1, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="page number must be at least 1"):
        paginate([1, 2], 0, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="page number out of range"):
        paginate(list(range(9)), 4, 3)
